1.6. COVID – 19 IN PREGNANCY:

•13% of UK population is BAME.
•55% of admissions are from BAME
•vitamin D deficiency in BAME – 94% are vitamin D deficient.
•Risk of COVID same as non-pregnant.
•Less fever and myalgia in pregnancy but more ICU admission.
•More admissions in 2nd half.

Risk Factor for Admission:

•BAME –(Black, Asian, Minority ethnicity.)
•BMI >25:
-75% obese
-35% over weight
-79% >40 BMI.
•Co – morbidities, DM, HTN.
•Age > 35
•Socioeconomic deprivation.

Effects on Fetus:

•No ed anomalies, miscarriages.
•Risk of IUGR – Possibility.
•Reasoning Neonatal outcome.
•SB double risk.
•PTB – iatrogenic due to suspected fetal or maternal compromise

ANC:

•Low threshold for MDT for BAME (more risk of severe & life threatening condition).
•Virtual appointments when physical exam not necessary.
•Smoking status @ booking and @ 36 weeks – opt – out basis referral.
•Influenza vaccine safe all Gestation.
• Ed risk of domestic abuse.

 

Suspected/ Confirmed COVID:

•Isolated services.
•PPE.

 

Recovered from COVID:

1.Mild, Mod, no symptoms:
-Usual care.
2.Severe, Critical, Admitted:
-Planned ANC by consultant obstetrician before discharge.
-Growth after 14 days of discharge unless pre – existing indication for earlier scan.

VTE Prophylaxis:

1.Self – isolation:
⇨Hydration.
⇨Mobilization.
⇨VTE risk assessment + LMWH according to case basis.

 

7 – 14 days or period of illness.

SARS – COVID-2 => Transient risk factor for VTE.

2.Admitted:
⇨Offer LMWH unless labor is within 12 hours or thrombocytopenia.
⇨MDT for dosage.
⇨Up to 10 days after discharge + during hospital stay.
⇨Within 6 weeks PP – Offer
⇨10 days after discharge.

Or

⇨Up to 6 weeks if ongoing morbidities PP.

 

 

IPC:

1.Asymptomatic.
2.Symptomatic.
3.Recovered.

 

1.Asymptomatic:
-Positive COVID test within 10 days.

+ low risk

 

Midwifery unit/ home birth.

-No CEFM.
-Discuss regarding CTG.
2.Symptomatic:
-Obstetric unit MDT:
⇨Obstetrician
⇨Neonatologist + nurse.
⇨Anesthetist.
⇨Midwife.
-COVID assessment by senior clinician.
-Hourly observation:
⇨Temp.
⇨RR.
⇨O2 – sat > 94%.
-Labor management as standard.
-CEFM.
-Latent phase @ home.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

3.Recovered:
-Admitted/ Self isolated same care.
-Serious/ critical illness

 

 

Personalized plan.

Symptoms Symptoms

MOD:

•Personalized.
•Shorten II0 stage if hypoxic/ exhausted.

•Obstetrician involvement.

Water birth:

•Asymptomatic can have water birth
•Cough, fever, feeling unwell avoid
•Transmission – unknown in water.
•PPE less effective when wet.

Analgesia:

•Entonox with mask can be given
•Epidural – informed discussion.
•Positive elective procedures @ end of list.
•Emergency c/s of positive COVID woman is done in 2nd theatre followed by full cleaning.

 

PNC:

•B.F is safe even confirmed COVID.
•Rooming in.
•Kangaroo Mother care can be done

Deterioration of COVID in pregnancy:

•Consider bacterial infection if TLC is increasing
•Don’t assume pyrexia as COVID.
•Consider other possibilities.

Inpatient criteria:

One of the following:

1.Loss of smell.
2.Clinical/ Radiological pneumonia.
3.ARDS.
4.Fever > 37.8 + cough or nasal discharge/ cough or SOB or sore throat or sneezing wheezing.

X – ray, CT:

⇨Chest pain, worsening hypoxia, RR > 22.

Consider pulmonary embolism/ Heart Failure.

Treatment of deteriorating COVID:

Warning signs Escalate urgently:

1.O2 requirement above 40%.
2.RR > 30.
3.oliguria
4.AKI
5.Drowsiness even O2 sat are normal.

 

⇨Fluid balance – given in boluses 250 – 500ml – assess fluid overload.
⇨Keep low threshold for antibiotics.
⇨MDT
-Physician.
-Obstetrician + midwife.
-Anesthetist.
-Neonatologist.
⇨VTE – thrombocytopenia < 50 => stop aspirin & LMWH + seek neonatologist opinion.
⇨Steroids:
-Prednisolone – 40mg OD orally for 10days or during Hospital admission whichever is sooner.
-Hydrocortisone – 8mg B.D I/v.
⇨Consider antiviral remdesivir.
⇨Feto maternal assessment and plan of delivery if required.
⇨Steroid + Mgso4 for PTB => should not delay.

 

Young women can compensate for deteriorating respiratory function and have normal O2 saturation. They collapse suddenly.

⇨Vaccination is safe and recommended
